technique_name: Describe techniques for preventing overfitting in machine learning
description: Techniques for preventing overfitting in machine learning include regularization, data augmentation, early stopping, ensembling, and testing various hyperparameters. Regularization is a technique used to reduce the complexity of the model, while data augmentation involves generating new data by perturbing existing data to reduce overfitting.
